shape.rationale: Square fox head, stepped ears/tail, lightning brow, articulated gauntlet paws and cuboid beacon plinths are readable and follow the official Spark Paw Fia reference.

lighting.rationale: Warm gold key and cool cyan rim separate the orange fox and real cue lights from violet clouds; no cue is identified by colour alone.

material.rationale: Bevelled shared geometry, coherent rough gold/stone materials and restrained real shadows give depth without noisy surface detail or disconnected styles.

composition.rationale: Square action poster retains face and cue in real lobby/Main/rail crops. Portrait and short-landscape arena fits keep both beacon targets unobstructed.

commercialQuality.rationale: Purpose-made illustration replaces the sparse test capture; polished block-citadel sky, consistent hero palette and shared UI produce a finished presentation at real thumbnail size.

overall.rationale: Separate rendered review covers actual phone, short-landscape and desktop surfaces, with no known remaining art correction; functional and independent QA remain separate.

assetScores.rationale: Source image has readable fox anatomy, one clear signal action and safe square composition.
Optimized1254px WebP retains the source composition and readable cyan/gold silhouette at actual lobby thumbnail scale.
Distant block citadels and clouds frame the real foreground without baking in false targets or a second hero.
One instanced bevelled geometry supports the articulated fox, platform and beacons with stable resource cost and coherent materials.

styleConsistency.rationale: Spark Paw Fia cuboids and cyan/gold/violet night palette agree across poster, live3D foreground and sky.

sharedUiUx.rationale: Main and Stage remain in shared owners; Styles hides the whole rail/briefing and uses the shared bottom slots. Result controls were separately rechecked.

cropScale.rationale: 1254px square delivery remains square in the lobby/Main and uses the native shared Stage cover; real3D camera fits the changing arena.

feedbackEffects.rationale: Visible native-input play shows finite cue lights, paw poses and streak emphasis. Reduced-motion settlement has no active-control bleed-through.

responsiveness.rationale: Five-size producer journeys pass; all applicable art surfaces have phone/short-landscape/desktop images. Short Styles uses its own scroll workspace.

reviewerCapability: Art Director (embedded Planner capability; separate rendered-surface inspection)
